title: Group a dashboard by a label

blocks.content: Group by splits each panel into one series per label value, without editing any query. In this guide you group the dashboard by `job`, compare the per-job results, and then remove the grouping.

blocks.tooltip: This demo dashboard has a filter variable with group by turned on.

blocks.content: To group the dashboard, choose a label in the **Group by** box:
In the **Group by** box, type `job` and select the **job** label.
blocks.tooltip: Group by sits next to the filters in the same control.

blocks.content: The **job** grouping is now a pill. Aggregating queries now return one series per job, so the **HTTP requests** graph shows a line for each job.
blocks.tooltip: Grouping applies to aggregations such as sum, avg, and count.

blocks.content: You grouped every aggregating panel by job without editing a query.
Remove the **job** grouping to return to a single total.
blocks.tooltip: Removing a grouping does not change the saved dashboard.

blocks.content: You removed the grouping, and the graph shows a single total again. To group by labels on your own dashboards, turn on **Enable group by** in the filter variable's settings.
